title: Rescuing Mingus with Buddy Collette and his call to Honolulu
summary: He and Collette bailed Mingus out of money trouble, and Mingus tracked him down in Honolulu after recording "Mingus Fingers" with Hampton.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: I thought so, too. Buddy Collette and I used to extricate him from all sorts of problems. He'd come out and check into the Ambassador, into a private cab, then
not have enough bread. So who rescued him? Buddy Collette and Red Callender. This is things that very few people know, but it happens to be one of the facts of...
Was this after he'd left Los Angeles, or while he was still living here?

Oh, this was after he'd left Los Angeles and had become a big name even! You know, he trusted us. He knew that if he was anywhere near us, everything would be all right. As a matter of fact, I was in Honolulu, and he had gone with Lionel Hampton -- this was something I didn't know anything about it. I don't know how he tracked me down, but he did. I had a girlfriend who used to run a record shop, and the phone rings, and it's a call from somewhere, and it's Charlie Mingus. He'd tracked me down, and he had just done "Mingus Fingers" with Lionel Hampton, so he wanted to make sure I knew about it! He was an uncanny type, yeah.
